alpha_definition: net_total_pnl - benchmark_net_total_pnl over the cell evaluation window, finite and > 0

benchmark.window_start: first bar where the cell signal is defined

conditional_edge.positive_effect: finite mean fwd_ret conditional minus unconditional same-symbol mean > 0
conditional_edge.recording: every finite positive effect; no minimum n/effect/DSR

edge_recording_rule.strategy_edge: evaluable cell with finite net matched-benchmark alpha > 0

execution_contract.calendar_signal: member(bar t+2) so the held close-to-close return covers a member session; never past 2024-12-31
execution_contract.fill: first bar strictly after t at rust_conservative_bar_range_v1 (BUY high+slip, SELL low-slip), integer-micros, same-bar fill forbidden
execution_contract.hold_semantics: desired while any qualifying event occurred in trailing N completed bars; no pyramiding
execution_contract.rebalance_anchor: canonical session ordinal since 2016-01-01 modulo interval
execution_contract.signal_knowledge: signal on bar t uses only bars <= t

flag_thresholds.cost_fragile: alpha - (strategy_costs - benchmark_costs) <= 0, i.e. doubling costs erases alpha

metric_definitions.concentration: max positive bucket / sum of positive buckets of per-bar alpha contribution by year / regime
metric_definitions.dsr: DEFERRED_FULL_POPULATION: effective-trial correction over the full population is infeasible; per-cell sharpe/skew/kurtosis/observations are recorded so research_multiple_testing_judge_v1 can run later
metric_definitions.exposure: fraction of window bars with a position held before the bar
metric_definitions.max_drawdown: peak-to-trough of cumulative net pnl including the zero start; flagged as a fraction of the 10000 budget
metric_definitions.sharpe: mean/std(ddof=1) of daily net pnl / 100000 over window bars * sqrt(252); null when std == 0
metric_definitions.universe_cell: sum of per-symbol simulations on the global session grid; capital 10000 per evaluable member
metric_definitions.win_loss: closed runs only; run pnl = net bars from entry bar through exit bar inclusive

ml_folds.label_purge: training rows require t+h strictly before test start
ml_folds.scheme: expanding walk-forward by calendar year, first test year requires >=504 prior rows

ordering: families S01..S20 in grid order; symbols sorted; cell identity independent of order

parameter_neighborhood.neighbor: same family and same symbol, equal on every other parameter, adjacent in that parameter's sorted unique grid values
parameter_neighborhood.parameter_island: positive cell with >=1 neighbor and positive-neighbor share < threshold; never deleted

regime_definition: SPY close > SPY SMA200 at the prior completed bar (RISK_ON else RISK_OFF)

replication.basis: per config: count of evaluable symbols whose cell has net alpha > 0 (conditional: effect > 0 per horizon)

retry_rules.infrastructure_retry: same trial, new attempt, same economics
